classification: Conservative resource-and-usage admission estimate; not an invoice or a verified remaining-credit balance. Credits and free allowances are excluded.

compute.method: Sum insert EVENTS, preserving repeated names. Count complete maximum lifetimes even when manually deleted early or a later operation failed. Add full restart/reset allowances again, rather than infer that their initial deadline was unchanged.

providerMeters.semantics: Network/logging/request metrics are DELTA, summed once. Storage v2 is a daily GAUGE including soft-deleted and noncurrent objects; charge its maximum for the entire 17-day window, rather than sum repeated gauges as bytes. No pagination in saved meter responses.
